verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is built for bulk changes. It parallelizes creation and modification of all non-dependent resources from one graph, and destroy mode tears down every remote object in one plan. It also offers for_each for provider configurations, a single variable change to update all modules, and -exclude to scope bulk runs. A community user confirms for_each on import blocks as a welcome bulk capability. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on resource-level for_each/count bulk patterns, documented for_each import usage beyond a community mention, and hands-on corroboration of large-scale bulk runs.
